cohort.0: The study enrolled 84 women who experienced stress urinary incontinence 3 months after either vaginal or caesarean birth.

finding.0: Stress urinary incontinence after delivery was found to be affected by mode of delivery, pelvic muscle floor weakness, perineal tear, BMI, newborn weight, and head circumference, with perineal tear significantly increasing SUI 7-fold.

mod_finding.0: There was a significant difference between mode of delivery and SUI following delivery (p<0.05).
